subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Should this external memory-core provider recovery PR wait for live Gateway/provider outage proof, or should a maintainer explicitly override the proof gate for deterministic manager-level coverage?
rationale: The code path appears plausible, but the repository policy requires external PRs to show real behavior proof unless maintainers intentionally override that gate.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Gateway memory_search transcript or logs showing primary outage, fallback activation, primary recovery, and returned memory results before merge.

options.title: Apply proof override
options.body: A maintainer can decide the deterministic MemoryIndexManager regression is enough for this low-scope provider recovery and mark proof overridden.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Gateway memory_search transcript or logs showing primary outage, fallback activation, primary recovery, and returned memory results before merge.
